book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The Tankadere was a small boat, but fast.
And Bunsby a skilled captain.

sentences.ar: وأول يومين، الريح كانت منيحة، والمركب طار عالمي.
sentences.en: And the first two days, the wind was good, and the boat flew over the water.

sentences.ar: وفوغ قاعد بالمؤخرة، بلا حركة، زي التمثال.
sentences.en: And Fogg sat in the stern, motionless, like a statue.
And Aouda beside him.

sentences.ar: وفيكس بالمقدمة، بيتطلع بالبحر، وما بيحكي.
sentences.en: And Fix in the bow, watching the sea, saying nothing.
And on the third day, Bunsby looked at the sky.
And said: a storm is coming.
Fogg said: from where?
Bunsby said: from the south.
And that is good, it pushes us forward.
But it will be strong.
Fogg said: sail into it.
Bunsby said: as you order.
And the storm came.

sentences.ar: ريح زي الجنون، والموج زي الجبال.
sentences.en: Wind like madness, waves like mountains.

sentences.ar: والمركب الزغير بيطلع فوق الموجة، وبينزل، وبيطلع.
sentences.en: And the little boat climbing the wave, and falling, and climbing.
And water coming in from every side.

sentences.ar: وبونسبي ماسك الدفة بإيديه الاتنين، وبيصرخ على بحارته.
sentences.en: And Bunsby holding the tiller with both hands, shouting at his crew.

sentences.ar: وعودا مربوطة بحبل، ووجهها أبيض، وما صرخت مرة.
sentences.en: And Aouda tied with a rope, her face white, and she did not scream once.

sentences.ar: وفوغ جنبها، بيتطلع بالبحر زي إنه بيتطلع بورق اللعب.
sentences.en: And Fogg beside her, watching the sea as if watching a hand of cards.
All night.
And in the morning, the wind dropped.
And the boat was whole.

sentences.ar: وبونسبي قال: يا سيد فوغ، هالليلة، ما كنت أظن نطلع منها.
sentences.en: And Bunsby said: Mr. Fogg, tonight, I did not think we would come through.
Fogg said: how far to Shanghai?
Bunsby said: a hundred miles.
And we have six hours.
And the American steamer leaves at seven.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: إذن خمسة عشر ميل بالساعة.
sentences.en: Fogg said: then fifteen miles an hour.
Go.
